subject.title: gh-issues skill: untrusted issue body injected directly into sub-agent prompt

question: Should gh-issues hardening land as a combined content-boundary plus child-capability design, or should maintainers split content wrapping/summarization from the per-spawn tool-policy API?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but the durable fix changes security-boundary and workflow semantics for spawned agents that process external GitHub content.

options.title: Bundle content and child-policy hardening
options.body: Treat issue/comment text as structured untrusted data and pair unattended workers with sandbox or per-spawn least-privilege tools once the API is accepted.

options.title: Land content boundary first
options.body: Wrap or summarize GitHub text before task construction while tracking child tool isolation separately in the per-spawn policy issue.

options.title: Defer until spawn policy settles
options.body: Keep this open without code changes until maintainers choose the permanent sessions_spawn tool-policy API.

recommendation.title: Bundle content and child-policy hardening
recommendation.body: Treat issue/comment text as structured untrusted data and pair unattended workers with sandbox or per-spawn least-privilege tools once the API is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: History ties this owner to sessions_spawn creation and security hardening around the same subagent boundary.
